_comment: Canonical AppPolicy document shape. client is the authority - it stores authorization rules for external application identities. Under the Phase 1 fail-closed model, any app lacking an active policy gets deny-all. A field mismatch breaks external app authorization and governance enforcement.
_consumers: client internal services (L4 Warden, governance verification)

app_policy._description: Authorization rules for an external application identity. Defines what collections, event types, and intents an app can access, along with rate limits and payload constraints. Under Phase 1 fail-closed, apps without an active policy receive deny-all.

app_id.description: External application identifier. Used as the document ID.

owner_user_id.description: User identity bound to the platform app certificate.

approved_by_user_id.description: Active first user who approved the enrollment request.

enrollment_request_id.description: Owner-approved platform enrollment request that created this policy.

certificate_serial.description: Serial number of the certificate associated with this policy.

certificate_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate associated with this policy.

allowed_collections.description: Collections this app is allowed to mutate. See collections.json.

allowed_event_types.description: Event types this app is allowed to publish. See events.json.

allowed_intents.description: Cloud intents this app is allowed to request. See intents.json.

rate_limit_rps.description: Maximum requests per second. 0 means no allowance (deny-all).

max_payload_bytes.description: Maximum payload size in bytes. 0 means no allowance.

require_l3_approval.description: Whether L3 (human) approval is required for governed actions from this app.
